steps.query:
float fM1
ref rF1
ref rB
ref rScan
ref rScanBase
float fX
float fY
float fZ
Begin Function { }
let fM1 := GetModIndex "FalloutNV.esm"
let rF1 := BuildRef fM1 374478
let rScan := GetFirstRef 201 2 0
while rScan != 0
  let rScanBase := rScan.GetBaseObject
  if rScanBase == rF1
    if rScan.GetSourceModIndex == 255
      if rScan.GetDisabled == 0
        let rB := rScan
      endif
    endif
  endif
  let rScan := GetNextRef
loop
if rB
  let fX := rB.GetPos X
  let fY := rB.GetPos Y
  let fZ := rB.GetPos Z
endif
SetFunctionValue (($ fX) + " " + ($ fY) + " " + ($ fZ))
End
